subject.title: [Bug]: When openclaw sends a link with an underscore to Feishu, the full hyperlink cannot be displayed

question: Should maintainers adopt one of the conflicting fork PRs for this Feishu underscore-URL bug, or sponsor a fresh same-repository fix?
rationale: The bug is valid and narrow, but existing no-new-fix-pr state plus conflicting linked fork candidates means another automatic branch could add duplicate churn without a maintainer choosing the landing path.

options.title: Sponsor a fresh same-repository fix
options.body: Queue one narrow Feishu plugin fix with regression tests and live Feishu proof, using the fork PRs only as source context.

options.title: Refresh one fork PR
options.body: Pick the better fork candidate, resolve conflicts, and require focused coverage plus real Feishu behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Wait for contributor update
options.body: Keep this issue open until a contributor updates a candidate branch into a mergeable, proven state.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a fresh same-repository fix
recommendation.body: Queue one narrow Feishu plugin fix with regression tests and live Feishu proof, using the fork PRs only as source context.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent Feishu send-path history make this the strongest available routing candidate for choosing the landing path.
